excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI 的工程师们花了数周时间，试图解释 Rockset 中那些神秘的崩溃问题。Rockset 是一款 C++ 数据基础设施服务，为 ChatGPT 的搜索和数据插件提供支持。函数似乎会返回错误的内存地址，栈指针在执行过程中似乎会偏移 8 个字节。团队提出的每一种假设都面临着有力的反证。这个 Bug 似乎根本不可能存在。

Functions appeared to return wrong memory addresses, and the stack pointer seemed to shift by 8 bytes during execution. Every hypothesis the team proposed was met with strong counterevidence. The bug seemed impossible.

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 20, the annual tech event "Hardcore Youth Tech Festival 5.0," spanning Alibaba's ATH business group and Taotian Group, kicked off simultaneously in Hangzhou and Beijing. The week-long festival features tech showcases, academic exchanges, an AI Hackathon, and more. During the opening ceremony, Taotian Group unveiled four latest technological achievements of the AIGX system: the Paitalitao full-modality real-time agent, the full-scenario AI creation workbench if Studio, the Coupella smart engine, and the Agentic recommendation system Dream. "The Hardcore Youth Tech Festival has been held for five consecutive years. Vigor and craftsmanship are the most valuable foundation of the festival and our entire team," said Zheng Bo, Alibaba ATH Vice President and Taotian Group Chief Scientist at the opening. "The four new AIGX technologies released today—from full-modality perception to content production, from causal inference to intent understanding—mark the evolution of AI from a tool to a true partner." It is reported that in the AIGI direction, the Paitalitao full-modality real-time agent has officially gone live. This technology upgrades the original "search by photo for similar items" tool into a video shopping companion that "accompanies you while shopping, helps you choose, and saves you money," enabling transition from "seeing" to "understanding" with a single command.

items.title: SoulAgent亮相WAIC 2026：智能参会重塑前沿知识传播范式
items.raw_excerpt: 2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议（第九届WAIC）以“智能伙伴 共创未来”为主题，于7月17日至20日在上海举办。作为全球人工智能领域规格最高、影响力最大的平台之一，WAIC 2026汇聚了来自全球的顶尖科学家、产业领袖与开发者，共同探讨AI技术前沿与产业落地。期间，AI开放计算与智能体技术生态论坛于7月19日召开，围绕智能体技术生态展开深入讨论。作为智源自研智能体产品，SoulAgent为参会嘉宾、观众与开发者提供了WAIC大会智能参会服务。   智能体能力落地：WAIC议程一键可查，SoulAgent在大会现场“活”起来         在WAIC 2026现场，参会者只需向SoulAgent提问 “明天有哪些论坛？”“WAIC AI Agent展区几点开始？”“7月19日的智能体技术生态论坛议程怎么安排？”等问题 ——SoulAgent便能精准返回对应日期、场地、议题及嘉宾信息。这是智能体对大会信息的结构化理解与主动服务：它知道你在问什么，知道答案在哪里，更知道如何把信息以你需要的方式呈现给用户。     SoulAgent：让前沿观点可沉淀、可复盘、可深度追问         大型技术论坛往往面临一个共同困境：议题密集硬核，嘉宾观点碰撞精彩，但会议结束后，大量前沿信息随人流散去，难以沉淀为可复用的知识资产。SoulAgent针对这一痛点，可为大会组织方提供覆盖论坛全流程的“智能听会”能力，支持会后内容总结，将多位嘉宾的演讲、圆桌讨论中分散的碎片化信息，转化为结构化的论坛总览、核心观点摘要与关键技术拆解，帮助参会者快速整理大会的专业内容知识点。 &n

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议（第九届WAIC）以“智能伙伴 共创未来”为主题，于7月17日至20日在上海举办。作为全球人工智能领域规格最高、影响力最大的平台之一，WAIC 2026汇聚了来自全球的顶尖科学家、产业领袖与开发者，共同探讨AI技术前沿与产业落地。期间，AI开放计算与智能体技术生态论坛于7月19日召开，围绕智能体技术生态展开深入讨论。作为智源自研智能体产品，SoulAgent为参会嘉宾、观众与开发者提供了WAIC大会智能参会服务。   智能体能力落地：WAIC议程一键可查，SoulAgent在大会现场“活”起来         在WAIC 2026现场，参会者只需向SoulAgent提问 “明天有哪些论坛？”“WAIC AI Agent展区几点开始？”“7月19日的智能体技术生态论坛议程怎么安排？”等问题 ——SoulAgent便能精准返回对应日期、场地、议题及嘉宾信息。这是智能体对大会信息的结构化理解与主动服务：它知道你在问什么，知道答案在哪里，更知道如何把信息以你需要的方式呈现给用户。     SoulAgent：让前沿观点可沉淀、可复盘、可深度追问         大型技术论坛往往面临一个共同困境：议题密集硬核，嘉宾观点碰撞精彩，但会议结束后，大量前沿信息随人流散去，难以沉淀为可复用的知识资产。SoulAgent针对这一痛点，可为大会组织方提供覆盖论坛全流程的“智能听会”能力，支持会后内容总结，将多位嘉宾的演讲、圆桌讨论中分散的碎片化信息，转化为结构化的论坛总览、核心观点摘要与关键技术拆解，帮助参会者快速整理大会的专业内容知识点。 &n
excerpt_i18n.en:
The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance (the 9th WAIC), under the theme “Intelligent Partners, Creating the Future Together”, was held in Shanghai from July 17 to 20. As one of the highest-level and most influential platforms in the global AI field, WAIC 2026 brought together top scientists, industry leaders, and developers from around the world to explore cutting-edge AI technologies and industrial applications. During the conference, the AI Open Computing and Agent Technology Ecosystem Forum took place on July 19, featuring in-depth discussions on the agent technology ecosystem. As an independently developed agent product from Ziyuan, SoulAgent provided intelligent conference assistance services for attendees, visitors, and developers at WAIC.

Agent capabilities in action: WAIC agenda at a glance — SoulAgent comes alive at the conference venue

At WAIC 2026, attendees only need to ask SoulAgent questions such as “What forums are there tomorrow?”, “When does the WAIC AI Agent exhibition area open?”, or “What is the agenda for the Agent Technology Ecosystem Forum on July 19?” — and SoulAgent can accurately return the corresponding date, venue, topics, and speaker information. This demonstrates the agent’s structured understanding of conference information and proactive service: it knows what you are asking, knows where the answer is, and knows how to respond.
excerpt_i18n.es: La Conferencia Mundial de Inteligencia Artificial 2026 y la Reunión de Alto Nivel sobre Gobernanza Global de la IA (9.ª WAIC), con el tema «Compañeros inteligentes, creando juntos el futuro», se celebró del 17 al 20 de julio en Shanghái. Como una de las plataformas de más alto nivel y mayor influencia en el ámbito de la IA global, WAIC 2026 reunió a científicos punteros, líderes industriales y desarrolladores de todo el mundo para debatir sobre las fronteras de la tecnología de IA y su aplicación en la industria. Durante el evento, el Foro sobre Ecología Tecnológica de Computación Abierta y Agentes Inteligentes se llevó a cabo el 19 de julio, donde se profundizó en el ecosistema tecnológico de los agentes inteligentes. items.raw_excerpt: Long video summarization presents significant challenges for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly in maintaining temporal fidelity over extended durations and producing summaries that are both semantically and temporally grounded. We introduce LVSum, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating long-form video summarization with fine-grained temporal alignment. LVSum comprises 72 diverse videos spanning 13 domains with an average duration of 16 minutes, each annotated with up to 10 human-generated summaries containing temporal references.
